snippet.title: Shion | New Hero Gameplay Trailer | Overwatch
snippet.description:
You don’t become the leader of the Hashimoto by playing it safe.

Introducing Shion - the newest hitscan Damage Hero joining the roster and the next major player in the Reign of Talon.

Armed with dual semi-auto pistols, an omnidirectional dash, and a motorcycle she can throw, Shion thrives in dangerous situations with nothing to lose and everything to gain.

Join her as she paints the town red when Season 3: Into the Tiger’s Den launches on June 16.

Overwatch is free to play on PC and console, now including Nintendo Switch™ 2"!

snippet.title: Something is Inside Your House...
snippet.description:
Something is Inside Your House...

And it's something horrifying.

Verity's voice actor (did an even GREATER job than part 1): @JustWhispy 
Friend in the video: @Twixxel_lesgo 

My Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/show/033vHZW7F2GVDiC44bHwfj

This is part 2 of the Minecraft Verity Series:
Something I trusted has been here longer than I knew. Every exit leads back home. Every village is empty. And the friend I brought to help me disappeared without a sound, while he just kept smiling.

NO,  you CANNOT repost dubbed versions of my videos. If you dubbed them, email me and I might add it as an official audio track.

snippet.title: Gatto | Teaser Trailer | In Theaters March 5, 2027
snippet.description:
Ciao Gatto
Watch the new teaser for Disney & Pixar's #Gatto, arriving in theaters March 5, 2027

Mark Ruffalo (“Poor Things,” “The Avengers,” “Spotlight, “Foxcatcher”) has joined the voice cast as the scrappy black cat Nero, and Laurence Fishburne (“The Matrix” trilogy, “Boyz n the Hood,” “What's Love Got to Do with It”) will voice the ruthless mob boss cat Rocco. The teaser trailer introduces Nero and Rocco as they question another cat in a funny interrogation scene.
In “Gatto,” after years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, Nero begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to Rocco, the local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose—unless Venice gets the better of him first.
“Gatto” is directed by Enrico Casarosa and produced by Andrea Warren, the filmmaking team behind the Oscar®-nominated feature “Luca.” The new film releases exclusively in theaters March 5, 2027.

ABOUT PIXAR ANIMATION STUDIOS
Pixar Animation Studios, a wholly owned subsidiary of The Walt Disney Company, is an Academy Award®-winning film studio with world-renowned technical, creative and production capabilities in the art of computer animation. The Northern California studio has created some of the most successful and beloved animated films of all time, including “Toy Story,” “Monsters, Inc.,” “Cars,” “The Incredibles,” “Ratatouille,” “WALL•E,” “Up,” “Brave,” “Inside Out,” “Coco,” “Soul,” “Turning Red,” “Elemental,” and “Inside Out 2.”

Se nos acabó el camino
Se nos fue secando el río
Y aunque le echamos mil ganas
No duró nuestro cariño

No hay culpables en la historia
No te apunto con el dedo
Simplemente no jaló
Y aceptarlo es lo que puedo

Al final del día, te juro
No me arrepiento de nada
Cada risa, cada beso
Cada pinche madrugada

Valieron toda la pena
Cada segundo contigo
Y eso me lo llevo conmigo

Y solo espero que algún día
Cuando te llegue el recuerdo
Cuando pienses en nosotros
No me guardes ni un te quiero

Solo espero sonrías
Y te digas en voz baja
Ese pinche vato loco
Y amargado, la neta sí me amaba

Que te acuerdes de lo bueno
Y que el tiempo borre el daño
Porque al final, mi reina
Te quise y no sabes cuánto

Yo sé que no fui perfecto
Con mi genio y mi locura
Pero te amé a mi manera
Con toda mi alma impura

Y aunque hoy ya no estés conmigo
Y otro sane tu quebranto
Siempre serás la mujer
A la que quise tanto

Cuando te llegue el recuerdo

No me guardes ni un te quiero

Y te digas en voz baja

Y que el tiempo borre el daño
Porque al final, mi reina
Te quise y no sabes cuánto

snippet.description:

snippet.description:
💟 Banda Tierra Sagrada - La Buena Y La Mala

⇨ Escucha nuestra Playlist: 💗 https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL6goqsAnH1QY1FYt3hw9JZgQCbJUVJGM5&si=i0_pe_KLAKuOp6Y0

💗 Romantic Music Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/0R4Z2Q6b496QOgcTdRfEy4?si=rK4ZLAf-Q0WiyyATEGByCQ

Banda Tierra Sagrada:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bandatierrasagrada?igsh=bXZ5aHdhOXB1dHM3

Encuentranos:
https://www.instagram.com/letras4k_

🎤 Letra:

¡Y esta es Tierra Sagrada
De Mazatlán, Sinaloa, viejo!

Me gusta tomarte la mano, entrando al cine
Presumir tu belleza con lo natural
De tu ser
Con tan poca pintura, luces tu hermosura y con ella tu piel

Y de otra, me encanta que pida la banda y que me dé besos en toda la cara
Que me intranquilice su falda cortita y su escote me incita a besar su boquita
Y mis manos perder
Dentro de su sostén

No, niego, me encanta pintar sonrisas en tu rostro
Son hermosas las tardes de sushi o de tomar café
Y ni yo me explico, la cursilería se me da tan bien

Pero en las parrandas, la otra me encanta, pues me sigue el rollo con mis camaradas
Bailando y pistiando en la madrugada y ya amaneciendo, vamos a la cama
Y, con sus uñas largas
Aruña mi espalda

Es un dilema
Es un problema, lo sé y lo sostengo
Y no está en mis manos, ser enamorado, ser un poco cursi, pero acelerado
Un ángel de día, un demonio de noche y si hay que decidir

Miren, plebes, no es que sea sin vergüenza, pero, si hay que decir, lo legal

Una en el día y la otra en la noche

Y de lo bueno, lo mejor, mi compa

snippet.title: We Just Completely BROKE Hunters.. Enjoy it! [Destiny 2 Hunter Build]
snippet.description:
YOUTUBE MEMBER:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCIyCSH_pqV_wOzVYm8s9Hkw/join

We Just Completely BROKE Hunters.. Enjoy! [Destiny 2 Hunter Build]

DISCORD: https://discord.gg/HmFvvKD
TWITTER: https://twitter.com/plunderthabooty
TWITCH: https://www.twitch.tv/plunderthabooty

https://dim.gg/mnpcp7y/1-Solar-Hunter-Build-Crackshot

I think we did it guys, we completely Broke the sandbox for the finally of Destiny 2.  

I don't even know where to begin with this! Keep in mind that I am on a Solar Hunter which arguably is suppose to have some of the worst survivability in hard content. Also I wasn't even using an Exotic weapon. I should have had on Anarchy or Dragons breath for even more destruction. The gameplay truly speaks for itself. My health bar up top hardly ever moves. Just watch it.

I jump head first into multiple champions, a ton of enemies. Even mini bosses and straight up bosses at the end of runs.

All Gameplay is from Ultimate difficulty where we are locked 30 power level under. 

I bet you never thought a Hunter could run around with Infinite Restoration, Cure, Woven Mail, Amplified and Overshields.

Well we can now..  By combining these Buffs we can run head first into anything and not give a care in the world about what's Infront of us. I have never felt as unkillable as this..

And that's Just on the Survivability Side.

But What about the Offensive side. Your seeing solar Ignitions going off, Arc Bolt charge lightning being called down. The Arc Jolt debuff zapping enemies left and right. Strand Unravel spreading throughout entire packs and strand threadlings popping out left and right chasing down enemies and adding overall damage. 

All of this is obtained by firing off one single weapon and using our class ability. I add in my melee ability here and there for more Ignitions but it really is pretty simple once you understand what's going on. My other 2 weapons were just used for Anti Champion purposes. I wasn't even using an Exotic weapon like I mentioned earlier in any of the gameplay which is just crazy..

Your artifact choice is everything and I urge you guys to think outside the box. I really believe a ton of builds can be made like this on all 3 classes. But even if you can't come up with it yourself that's okay, That's what I am here for! I won't leave you guys hanging in the Finally of Destiny 2. 

For A solar Hunter you would think or lean too something like the Hunters Journal Artifact. With Mods in it like Solar Fulmination and Radiant Orbs to match your subclass. And that can be okay, but what Solar Hunter lacks is survivability the most. That's understandable because Solar Ignitions are so powerful when they go off. There is suppose to be some sort of trade off right? Well not anymore.

You might think the Queensfoil Censer Artifact with Solar is the play with mods like Rays of Precision to ignite enemies when you defeat them with precision shots and your radiant.

Well we through conventional thought process out the window and take the Tablet of Ruin Artifact which doesn't even have a Solar tag on it with what it works best with. We also don't even use a Fusion rifle, glaive or trac rifle.

This Artifact supplies all those powerful buffs and debuffs that we won't over earlier and it's all done in a very seamless way.

You'll see everything from a super speed drill to a delivery attack drone, offering new "tips and tricks" for your gameplay. These inventive "building houses" and devices are sure to enhance your "virtual reality" experience on "meta quest".

In Animal Company, players use GOOP to build cool and creative inventions. If you use Animal Company Goop to make Animal Company Goop Builds, you can make awesome things like mechs, attack drones, helicopters, and even fly with goop builds in Animal Company.

In this video, I play Animal Company and use Goop crafting to build a variety of crazy and powerful creations, including a motorcycle, an attack drone, a super drill, an upgraded backpack, and a gun with effectively infinite ammo. Goop is one of the most important crafting mechanics in Animal Company, allowing players to attach items together to create custom builds, vehicles, weapons, and tools. Throughout this video, I experiment with different Goop combinations to see what is possible, pushing the limits of Animal Company crafting by building functional machines and overpowered setups that are not normally available through standard gameplay. This includes testing mobility builds like a motorcycle for fast movement, combat builds like an attack drone for fighting enemies, and utility builds like an improved backpack for better storage and efficiency.

Each build in this Animal Company video focuses on a different aspect of Goop crafting, including movement, combat, and resource gathering. I test how each creation performs in real gameplay scenarios, including fighting monsters, exploring the map, and completing objectives. The super drill is designed to increase mining efficiency, the infinite ammo gun build explores how Goop can be used to bypass normal weapon limitations, and the attack drone showcases how creative players can automate combat using attached weapons and mechanics. This video highlights advanced Animal Company Goop crafting strategies, creative builds, and experimental mechanics, showing how players can use Goop to create powerful machines, vehicles, and weapons that completely change how the game is played.
